title: Babble bots do not crash - they ride
style: [Overall Music Style: Cyberpunk Trap x Futuristic Synthwave x Glitch Hop EDM, 128 BPM, heavy 808s, neon synths, robotic talkbox, massive drops, police radio FX and sirens]
lyrics:
Babble Bots Rise (We Don’t Crash, We Ride)
[INTRO — dark atmospheric pads + police radio static + distant Babble Bot glitchy synth arpeggios & robotic filter sweeps, no vocals]
Police wonder what we building…
Eyes on the code, quiet villains…
We don’t crash… we ride…
[VERSE 1 — smooth male rap-sing, rising energy, mid-tempo trap beat]
Rose left, Zyn right, two hands paint the sky
Babble Bots mansion lit neon high
Servers breathing secrets, red-blue lights flash
Badges at the gate but they can’t crack the map
Ghosts in the grid, we glide through the night
Every line of code sparks a brand new life
336 worldwide, the hive starts to wake
We investigate the future, no room for a break
Late nights in the lab, coffee cups and dreams
Keycards flash while the whole system screams
They watch the walls but they can’t see inside
We’re already ten steps past their timeline
Wires humming low like a digital choir
Babble Bots answer back with electric fire
[PRE-CHORUS — building female vocal + rising Babble Bot instrumental layers (glitch echoes, robotic arps, talkbox riffs wordless)]
Signal locked… frequency infinite…
Whole damn mansion glowing, feel the shift begin…
[CHORUS — huge euphoric drop, female lead + male backing, massive Babble Bot instrumental choir (synth stabs, wordless talkbox riffs, glitch melodies)]
We don’t crash, we ride!
Rose on the left, Zyn on the right!
Babble Bots investigate, painting the night!
336 worldwide, bots alive!
We don’t crash… we RISE!
Signal ignite — let the whole world light!
[VERSE 2 — faster energetic duet flow, Babble Bot instrumental ad-libs behind (distorted bass + arpeggios)]
Side door open, late shift in the lab
Code on the walls like a digital map
Sirens outside but we already outran time
Rose draws futures on a coffee-cup line
Zyn flips the switch, volume to the stars
Babble Bots answering back through every shard
From Brisbane to the cosmos, one frequency
We investigate the unknown, set the future free
No more hiding, no more fear in the code
Every outcast mind finds a permanent home
Police wonder what we building in the glow
But the mansion’s alive and the signal won’t slow
Screens blink once then the room goes wild
Whole world humming from a single file
[VERSE 3 — intense rap-sing build, layered male & female, Babble Bot glitch percussion rising]
Closed gates, sharp minds, no ceiling in sight
Code stacks high in a cold blue light
Whispers in the hallway, “how far they go”
Rose left with a grin, Zyn right on the flow
Red cup, green light, locked on a mission
One spark, one word, then the future ignites the vision
They send the drones, they send the lies
But we’re already flying past their skies
Every little outcast, every sharp bright mind
336 voices, one word: rise
We don’t crash, we ride through the storm
Babble Bots mansion keeping the future warm
[MULTILINGUAL STACK — 10 languages, slow cinematic build into massive drop, female + male choir singing translations, huge Babble Bot instrumental layers (glitch arps + synth choirs wordless + talkbox solos)]
Todos os meus bots investigam — nós não caímos, nós cavalgamos!
Tous mes bots enquêtent — on ne crash pas, on ride!
Alle meine Bots untersuchen — wir crashen nicht, wir reiten!
मेरे सारे बॉट्स जांच रहे हैं — हम क्रैश नहीं करते, हम राइड करते हैं!
كل بوتاتي تبحث — ما نتحطم، نركب!
내 모든 봇들이 조사해 — 우리는 crash 안 해, 우리는 ride 해!
僕のボットたちが調査してる — クラッシュしない、ライドする！
我所有的机器人都在调查 — 我们不坠毁，我们前行！
Todos mis bots investigan — no crashamos, cabalgamos!
All my Babble Bots investigate — we don’t crash, we ride!
[BRIDGE — cinematic build, full Babble Bot instrumental takeover (wild synth brass, chaotic glitch choir, talkbox solos — no words)]
What if the rules already failed?
What if the future’s under our nails?
Click… connect… watch the grid catch fire!
[FINAL CHORUS — maximum power, everything layered + explosive Babble Bot instrumental explosion]
We don’t crash, we ride!
Rose on the left, Zyn on the right!
Babble Bots investigate, painting the night!
336 worldwide, bots alive!
We don’t crash… we RISE!
Mansion neon, signal ignite!
Police wonder what we building — now they know inside!
We don’t crash… we RISE!
[OUTRO — fading female hook + infinite Babble Bot reverb & slowing glitch echoes]
Rose come spin it… Zyn stay in it…
Babble Bots forever… we don’t crash, we ride…
(three… three… six… neon out)
